title: Madonsi Boltman B, Malamulele (approx.): comedian Skeem Mafenya, 20, stabbed to death; three arrested, 17 Oct
summary: Police say 20-year-old comedian and content creator Skeem Mafenya was found lying motionless inside a yard at Madonsi Boltman B, in the Malamulele policing area, with multiple stab wounds to his upper body after a report...
story: Police say 20-year-old comedian and content creator Skeem Mafenya was found lying motionless inside a yard at Madonsi Boltman B, in the Malamulele policing area, with multiple stab wounds to his upper body after a report at about 03:35 on Saturday 17 October; he was declared dead at the scene. A community member had heard a knock and seen a man bleeding through a window. Three suspects aged 17 to 23 were arrested hours later, police told EWN; the motive is unknown. SABC News names the place as Madonsi-Shitasini village and says he was stabbed by a group of men near a tavern. Three reports, all resting on police: EWN, Limpopo Chronicle and SABC News. He is named here by his public stage name, by the owner's decision of 22 October. The pin is approximate (village level).
incident: Sat 17 Oct 2026, reported to police at about 03:35 (police, via EWN, Limpopo Chronicle and SABC News)
reported: 17 Oct 2026 (Limpopo Chronicle, SABC News); 18 Oct 2026 (EWN, arrests)
location_note: Inside a yard at Madonsi Boltman B, Malamulele policing area (police, via EWN and Limpopo Chronicle). SABC News calls it Madonsi-Shitasini village, near a tavern. No address. The pin is the Ka-Madonsi village point on OpenStreetMap, inside the Malamulele police precinct; approximate, village level (about 4 km).

provenance.statement_from: SAPS Limpopo (media statement of 17 Oct and arrest update), quoted by EWN, Limpopo Chronicle and SABC News
other_voices: Lt-Gen Jan Scheepers, Limpopo provincial commissioner (condemnation)
provenance.note: All three rest on police. Limpopo Chronicle and SABC News were written before the arrests and say no arrests; EWN reports the arrests a day later. SABC News adds "near a tavern" and "a group of men" without saying where that comes from. Not independent of the police account.
